text: Two types share one rule: the soft fresco is cut small and not cooked, ripened a few weeks; the semi-hard stagionato is cut finer, may be cooked a little, salted longer and ripened four months or more. Only whole sheep's milk of Tuscany and nearby areas may be used.

steps.note: The curd is cooked only for the semi-hard type, aged four months or more.
The whey is drained by hand pressing, or in a steam-heated room.

microbes.name: native, natural or selected lactic cultures

steps.note: The cheese is ripened at least 20 days for the soft type, or 4 months for the semi-hard one.
